title: Minnesota lawyer suspended over fake AI case citations

reading.body:
The incident title identifies a Minnesota lawyer who was suspended after submitting fake case citations generated by an AI system. Beyond that, the underlying article text is not available in the provided data, so the specific AI tool used, the number of fabricated citations, the court involved, and the details of the suspension are not established here.

What the title does confirm is a familiar failure mode: a generative AI system produced citations to legal cases that do not exist, and a legal professional submitted them in a proceeding without independent verification. That failure sits at the point where a user accepted AI output as accurate and a human check, checking citations against actual legal databases, did not occur before filing.

Whether the lawyer acted negligently or in deliberate disregard of professional rules is not established by this record. A suspension is a disciplinary finding, but the full record of that proceeding is not available in the summary provided.
